title: AI Powered Graphic Designing – Advanced
subtitle: 6 months · 24 weeks · Advanced · 4 days a week, 2 hours a day
summary: Professional graphic designing for print and digital media: CorelDRAW, Urdu designing in InPage, Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and AI design tools, ending with a professional portfolio, a freelancing profile and a final capstone project.
expert: At the end you can take a client brief from idea to finished brand, print and social media work across CorelDRAW, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva and InPage, use AI tools responsibly, and present it in a professional portfolio.

benchmarks.title: Design principles
benchmarks.detail: Understand and apply the elements and principles of graphic design: colour theory, typography, layout and visual hierarchy.

benchmarks.title: CorelDRAW
benchmarks.detail: Use CorelDRAW for vector design, print media and branding projects.

benchmarks.title: Urdu designing
benchmarks.detail: Create Urdu layouts in InPage for notices, advertisements, invitation cards, certificates and publications.

benchmarks.title: Digital design
benchmarks.detail: Use Canva for social media posts, covers, stories, campaigns and presentations.

benchmarks.title: Print and digital output
benchmarks.detail: Prepare designs to the size and file format that print and digital media need (PDF, JPG, PNG).

benchmarks.title: Photoshop
benchmarks.detail: Use Adobe Photoshop for photo editing, retouching, manipulation, product editing and social media ads.

benchmarks.title: Illustrator
benchmarks.detail: Use Adobe Illustrator for vector drawing, typography, branding, icons, mascots and illustrations.

benchmarks.title: Branding
benchmarks.detail: Develop brand identities, packaging, labels, mockups and creative concepts, with AI assistance where it helps.

benchmarks.title: AI tools
benchmarks.detail: Use ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, Microsoft Designer, Leonardo AI, Ideogram AI, Clipdrop and Remove.bg in a responsible design workflow.

benchmarks.title: Portfolio and freelancing
benchmarks.detail: Prepare a professional portfolio and understand Behance, LinkedIn, Fiverr, Upwork and working with clients.

benchmarks.title: Capstone
benchmarks.detail: Complete an integrated final capstone project demonstrating advanced graphic designing skills.
